title: SimRetract: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robotic Assistance for Retractor Take-Over in Open Surgery
summary: We demonstrate the first zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for a surgeon-robot collaboration task in open surgery: retractor take-over. A robot arm takes a retractor from the surgeon's hand and preserves retraction at handoff, using a policy trained only on simulated demonstrations, without human demonstrations or real-world fine-tuning. Imitation learning from real demonstrations is limited by collection and labeling costs, and by performance degradation when the environment changes. Our framework, SimRetract, generates simulated demonstrations designed for transfer: the policy observes masked instrument images and grasp geometry, learns to recover from off-nominal states, and acts with margin for execution drift. Deployed zero-shot, it grasps the retractor in 90% of 50 surgeon-defined phantom presentations and preserves retraction at handoff in 78%. Results on unseen retractors suggest potential for generalization to instruments with similar grasp geometry. Across ten policy configurations and 1,200 simulated and real trials, we localize the sim-to-real gap to components: in simulation, grasp rates across ablations span 80-96%, while on the real robot removing the instrument mask alone drops performance to 22% grasped and 12% held. Transfer-oriented design thus makes zero-shot sim-to-real transfer feasible for a surgical assistance task without human demonstrations. Code is available here: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/simretract-58D2.
tldr: SimRetract achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for a surgical robot policy that takes a retractor from a surgeon and maintains retraction, trained only on simulated demonstrations without human data or real-world fine-tuning. Real-robot phantom tests show 90% grasp success and 78% retraction preservation, with ablations identifying key transfer-oriented design choices.
tldr_zh: SimRetract 实现了手术机器人从仿真到真实环境的零样本迁移：策略仅使用仿真演示训练，无需人类示范或真实微调，即可从外科医生手中接过牵开器并维持牵拉状态。在真实模型测试中，抓取成功率达 90%，保持牵拉成功率达 78%，并通过消融实验定位了关键迁移设计因素。
summary_zh: 我们展示了在开放手术中外科医生-机器人协作任务——牵开器接管——的首次零样本仿真到现实迁移。机器人手臂从外科医生手中接过牵开器，并在交接时保持牵开状态，所使用的策略仅基于仿真演示训练，无需人类演示或真实世界微调。从真实演示中进行模仿学习受到数据采集和标注成本的限制，并且在环境变化时会出现性能下降。我们的框架SimRetract生成专为迁移设计的仿真演示：策略观察掩膜后的器械图像和抓取几何结构，学习从非标称状态中恢复，并以执行漂移的余量采取行动。零样本部署时，在50种外科医生定义的体模展示中，抓取成功率达到90%，在交接时保持牵开状态的成功率为78%。对未见过的牵开器的结果表明，该方法具有泛化到具有相似抓取几何结构的器械的潜力。在十种策略配置和1200次仿真及真实试验中，我们将仿真到现实差距定位到具体组件：在仿真中，各消融配置的抓取成功率为80%–96%，而在真实机器人上，仅移除器械掩膜就导致性能下降至抓取率22%、保持率12%。因此，面向迁移的设计使得零样本仿真到现实迁移在没有人类演示的外科辅助任务中变得可行。代码可在此处获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/simretract-58D2。

title: Active Constraints for Simultaneous Guidance and Safety in Handheld Micromanipulation
summary: In micromanipulation, erroneous hand motion limits unaided manipulation accuracy, which can affect task performance and safety in critical applications like microsurgery. Handheld robots (micromanipulators) enable motion accuracy beyond human limits by providing robotic assistance in a low-cost, compact, intuitive form factor. Particularly, active constraints are an effective form of robotic assistance, which aids the operator by restricting the robot's permissible motion based on task-specific requirements or objectives, thereby providing task guidance and enforcing safety. However, existing formulations of active constraints for handheld systems are limited, most notably because of the inability to provide guidance and enforce safety simultaneously. Implementing active constraints with optimization-based methods can address these limitations, but existing implementations are designed for free-standing robots, and neglect that handheld robots actuate relative to the operator's hand with a limited workspace. In this work, we propose an optimization-based active constraint framework for handheld micromanipulation that enables simultaneous guidance and safety enforcement. The formulation was implemented in a handheld robot and demonstrated on a medically relevant artificial task. Results show that the proposed formulation reduced safety violation rate by more than two orders of magnitude relative to baselines, while recovering the threefold accuracy loss from enforcing safety alone.
tldr: Proposes an optimization-based active constraint framework for handheld micromanipulators that simultaneously provides task guidance and safety enforcement, demonstrated on a medically relevant task with large reductions in safety violations and recovery of accuracy.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于优化的手持显微操作主动约束框架，可同时实现任务引导与安全限制；在医学相关任务中，安全违规率大幅降低，并恢复因仅安全约束损失的三倍精度。
summary_zh: 在显微操作中，手部错误运动会限制无辅助操作的精度，进而影响显微手术等关键应用中的任务表现与安全性。手持式机器人（显微操作器）通过提供机器人辅助，以低成本、紧凑、直观的外形实现超越人类极限的运动精度。其中，主动约束是一种有效的机器人辅助形式，它根据任务特定要求或目标限制机器人的允许运动，从而为操作者提供任务引导并确保安全性。然而，现有针对手持系统的主动约束公式存在局限，最主要的是无法同时提供引导和确保安全。采用基于优化的方法实现主动约束可以解决这些局限，但现有实现是为独立式机器人设计的，忽略了手持机器人相对于操作者手部运动且工作空间有限的特点。在本研究中，我们提出了一种面向手持式显微操作的基于优化的主动约束框架，能够同时实现引导与安全约束。该公式已在一台手持式机器人上实现，并在一个医学相关的人工任务上进行了验证。结果表明，与基线相比，所提出的公式将安全违规率降低了两个数量级以上，同时弥补了仅执行安全约束所带来的三倍精度损失。

title: Disparity Laundering: Consensus Without Fairness in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Clinical large language models are increasingly fielded as multi-agent teams, on the assumption that deliberation averages out individual error. It does not average out bias. Across a full factorial of five model families and four aggregation topologies on 120 real MIMIC-IV emergency cases under counterfactual demographic swaps, no configuration neutralizes the disparity: all 20 cells commit the direction of their agents' independent answers, giving Black patients more acute triage. Every model has a topology that amplifies its baseline gap, but which one varies by model, so no design is reliably safe or reliably amplifying: the disparity is relocated, never removed. Late-stage fixes fail: fairness instructions and demographic masking leave the gap untouched, and per-agent self-debiasing widens it, because the bias is already encoded in the agents' ordinary clinical numbers. We call this disparity laundering; the audits now applied to clinical AI, per model, per output, per version, can certify the parts but never the committed decision. Interventions close the gap exactly when they make counterfactual versions visible inside the system and pool them, through deliberation, into the committed decision. A diverse-perspective ensemble does both while keeping the team, with no retraining or architectural change: the disparity falls by 67 to 94% where all five perspectives pool at every round, and the one topology that never pools them is the one it cannot reliably repair. Medical multi-agent systems do not filter demographic bias; they launder it into plausible decisions no single-version audit can catch, and the only defense is to make the bias visible.
tldr: This paper shows that clinical multi-agent systems do not remove demographic bias but launder it into committed decisions that single-version audits cannot catch; across many models and aggregation topologies, disparities persist or shift, and only a diverse-perspective ensemble that pools all perspectives substantially reduces the gap.
tldr_zh: 本文通过反事实人口统计交换和多种模型/拓扑组合，证明临床多智能体系统无法消除偏见，只会将“差异”洗白为看似合理的决策；提出“多样视角集成”作为无需重训即可大幅降低差异的干预。
summary_zh: 临床大语言模型正越来越多地以多智能体团队的形式部署，其假设是集体 deliberation 会平均掉个体错误。但它不会平均掉偏见。在包含五个模型家族和四种聚合拓扑的全因子设计中，基于120个真实MIMIC-IV急诊病例，并在反事实人口统计交换条件下，没有任何配置能够消除这种差异：全部20个单元都沿用了其智能体独立答案的方向，导致黑人患者获得更紧急的分诊等级。每个模型都有一种拓扑会放大其基线差距，但具体是哪种拓扑因模型而异，因此没有哪种设计是可靠安全或可靠放大的：差异被转移了，却从未被消除。后期修复措施无效：公平性指令和人口统计信息屏蔽对差距毫无影响，而单个智能体的自我去偏反而扩大了差距，因为偏见已经编码在智能体日常的临床数值之中。我们将此称为“差异洗白”；目前应用于临床AI的审计——逐模型、逐输出、逐版本进行——可以认证各个部分，却无法认证最终的集体决策。干预措施只有在使反事实版本在系统内部可见并将它们通过 deliberation 汇集到集体决策中时，才能缩小差距。一个多样化视角的集成既能做到这两点，又无需重新训练或改变架构，同时保持团队不变：当所有五个视角在每个轮次都进行汇集时，差距下降了67%至94%；而唯一从不汇集这些视角的拓扑，恰恰是它无法可靠修复的。医学多智能体系统并不能过滤人口统计偏见；它们将偏见洗白成看似合理的决策，而任何单一版本的审计都无法捕捉到这一点，唯一的防御就是让偏见可见。

title: SparseTokenGS: Gaussian-based Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction via Reusable Token Pool
summary: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography is widely used for fast, low-dose volumetric imaging and lesion localization in dentistry and image-guided interventions, but it introduces severe artifacts. Feed-forward Gaussian methods transfer the reconstruction cost to training and decode each coordinate from projection-aligned features and neighboring anchors. However, information from the whole scan is written only when the field is constructed and cannot be retrieved during coordinate decoding, leaving the volume inconsistent within the scan. This is a common limitation of such methods: once the field is fixed, decoding uses only local features and reconstruction quality drops substantially. We propose SparseTokenGS, a Gaussian-based method for sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography reconstruction via a reusable token pool. Anchor Token Fusion and Point-Token Attention query this shared pool at the anchors and at the query coordinates, respectively. The local Gaussian prior is retained, and the volume is reconstructed in one forward pass, without per-scan optimization or a projection-domain loss. On three public chest and dental datasets, SparseTokenGS achieves the highest reconstruction performance among the compared methods. On clinical dental scans, reconstruction from only six projections reaches 29.51 decibels in peak signal-to-noise ratio and a structural similarity of 0.842 against the full-view reference, and off-the-shelf tooth-and-pulp segmentation keeps these structures separable for root-canal localization. Experiments on volcanic rock and chicken show performance after same-object adaptation. A reusable token pool gives feed-forward reconstruction a mechanism that keeps scan-wide context available through decoding and can benefit future rapid clinical lesion localization and analysis. The code is available at: https://github.com/FrankDengAI/SparseTokenGS.
tldr: SparseTokenGS introduces a reusable token pool for feed-forward Gaussian-based sparse-view CBCT reconstruction, enabling scan-wide context to be queried during coordinate decoding and achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality on dental and chest datasets without per-scan optimization.
tldr_zh: SparseTokenGS 提出一种可复用 token 池，用于基于高斯的前馈稀疏视图 CBCT 重建，使解码阶段能查询全扫描范围上下文，并在牙科和胸部数据集上取得领先重建质量，且无需逐扫描优化。
summary_zh: 稀疏视图锥形束计算机断层扫描因其快速、低剂量体积成像及在牙科和图像引导介入治疗中的病灶定位能力而被广泛使用，但它会引入严重的伪影。前馈高斯方法将重建成本转移到训练阶段，并从投影对齐的特征和邻近锚点解码每个坐标。然而，整个扫描的信息仅在构建场时写入，在坐标解码期间无法检索，导致场内体积与扫描不一致。这是此类方法的常见局限：一旦场固定，解码仅使用局部特征，重建质量大幅下降。我们提出SparseTokenGS，一种基于高斯的方法，通过可复用令牌池实现稀疏视图锥形束计算机断层扫描重建。锚点令牌融合和点-令牌注意力分别在锚点和查询坐标处查询该共享池。该方法保留局部高斯先验，并在单次前向传播中重建体积，无需逐扫描优化或投影域损失。在三个公开的胸部及牙科数据集上，SparseTokenGS在对比方法中取得了最高的重建性能。在临床牙科扫描中，仅用六个投影重建即可达到29.51分贝的峰值信噪比和0.842的结构相似性（相对于全视角参考），且现成的牙齿与牙髓分割能保持这些结构的可分离性，用于根管定位。在火山岩和鸡肉上的实验展示了同对象适配后的性能。可复用令牌池为前馈重建提供了一种机制，使扫描级上下文在解码过程中保持可用，并可能有益于未来快速的临床病灶定位与分析。代码可在：https://github.com/FrankDengAI/SparseTokenGS 获取。

title: PulmoWorld: An Asynchronous Multimodal Medical World Model for Longitudinal Pneumonia Dynamics
summary: Pneumonia changes across respiration, inflammation, and organ function, while the measurements that describe it arrive at different times and are often incomplete. We introduce PULMOWORLD, a world model for longitudinal pneumonia dynamics that connects asynchronous state estimation, recursive simulation, and evidence-constrained planning. History-aware filtering separates state propagation from observation-driven correction, so a measurement updates the shared belief only when it is observed. That belief supports recursive forecasts of clinical values and modality representations, and summaries of future prognosis. Cap-MBRL searches imagined continuations inside an authorized action set and replaces a frozen fallback only when a candidate meets the risk budget and a predicted-cost margin. On the pneumonia cohort MASS, recursive forecasts are competitive with task-trained sequence models, and simulated future states retain prognostic information. Trained separately on public MIMIC-IV-CXR chest radiographs and clinical trajectories, this model improves prognostic discrimination over latest-value fusion in development and is competitive on long-horizon error on the locked pneumonia panel. In five known-mechanism MASS-Syn environments, Cap-MBRL lowers selection regret relative to direct fallback execution.
tldr: PULMOWORLD is a multimodal medical world model that handles asynchronous, incomplete pneumonia data via history-aware state estimation, recursive forecasting, and evidence-constrained planning, showing competitive prognostic performance on pneumonia cohorts.
tldr_zh: PULMOWORLD 是一种多模态医学世界模型，通过历史感知状态估计、递归预测和证据约束规划来处理异步且不完整的肺炎数据，在肺炎队列上展现出具有竞争力的预后性能。
summary_zh: 肺炎在呼吸、炎症和器官功能方面的变化各不相同，而描述这些变化的测量数据却在不同时间到达，且往往不完整。我们提出了PULMOWORLD，一个用于纵向肺炎动态建模的世界模型，它将异步状态估计、递归模拟和证据约束规划相结合。历史感知滤波将状态传播与观测驱动的校正分离，因此只有在观测到某个测量值时，共享信念才会被更新。该信念支持对临床值和模态表示的递归预测，以及未来预后的摘要。Cap-MBRL在授权动作集内搜索想象延续，并且仅当候选方案满足风险预算和预测成本边际时，才替换冻结的回退方案。在肺炎队列MASS上，递归预测与任务训练的序列模型表现相当，模拟的未来状态保留了预后信息。该模型在公共MIMIC-IV-CXR胸部X光片和临床轨迹上分别训练，在开发集上相比最新值融合改善了预后判别能力，并在锁定肺炎面板上的长时程误差方面具有竞争力。在五个已知机制的MASS-Syn环境中，Cap-MBRL相比直接回退执行降低了选择遗憾。

title: Real-time volumetric MRI-guided MLC tracking: A feasibility study
summary:
Background and purpose:
  The MR SIGnature MAtching (MRSIGMA) was recently proposed as a real-time free-breathing 3D MR imaging technique with an imaging latency of 148 ms. It is a powerful tool for intrafractional motion monitoring for disease sites such as those in the abdominal region. This study presents a proof-of-concept MLC tracking system for dynamic adaptation of the radiation treatment based on the real-time target localization facilitated by MRSIGMA on a 1.5 T MR-Linac.
  Material and methods:
  An MLC tracking interface was developed for integration with MRSIGMA. The centroid position of a moving target was computed in real time by MRSIGMA, which was then processed by a predictive filter to account for imaging and MLC adjustment latencies. The MLC leaves were repositioned by rigid translation. To validate the MLC tracking process, a 10 cm circular field was delivered to a moving phantom for a series of sinusoidal motions and patient motion. A clinical pancreas SBRT plan was also delivered with the patient motion trace.
  Results:
  For the circular field, geometric errors of <1.8 mm and overall system latency of < 125 ms were achieved for all motion traces. Compared to no tracking, MLC tracking remarkably improved the dosimetric accuracy for the circular field and the clinical pancreas plan, with an average Gamma passing rate increased from 87.1% to 99.9% based on a 3%/2mm criteria.
  Interpretation:
  A 3D MRI-guided MLC tracking technique was developed and validated on a clinical MR-Linac. Preliminary results demonstrated great dosimetric improvements with MLC tracking for treatments with moving targets.
tldr: This feasibility study integrates MRSIGMA real-time volumetric MRI with an MLC tracking interface on an MR-Linac, using predictive filtering and rigid leaf shifts to track moving targets; phantom and pancreas plan tests show sub-2 mm errors, <125 ms latency, and improved gamma passing rates.
tldr_zh: 这项可行性研究将MRSIGMA实时三维MRI与MR-Linac上的多叶准直器（MLC）跟踪接口相结合，通过预测滤波和叶片刚性平移来跟踪运动目标；模体和胰腺SBRT计划实验显示几何误差小于1.8 mm、系统延迟小于125 ms，并显著提高了伽马通过率。
summary_zh:
摘要：
背景与目的：
MR信号特征匹配（MRSIGMA）技术近期被提出作为一种实时自由呼吸三维MR成像方法，其成像延迟为148 ms。该技术对于腹部等部位的靶区内运动监测具有强大的作用。本研究展示了一种基于MRSIGMA在1.5 T MR-Linac上实现的实时靶区定位，并用于动态调整放射治疗的概念验证型MLC跟踪系统。

材料与方法：
开发了与MRSIGMA集成的MLC跟踪接口。MRSIGMA实时计算运动靶区的质心位置，随后通过预测滤波器进行处理，以补偿成像和MLC调整延迟。MLC叶片通过刚性平移进行重新定位。为验证MLC跟踪过程，对运动模体施加一系列正弦运动和患者运动，并投照10 cm圆形射野。同时，使用患者运动轨迹执行了一个临床胰腺SBRT计划。

结果：
对于圆形射野，所有运动轨迹的几何误差均小于1.8 mm，整体系统延迟小于125 ms。与无跟踪相比，MLC跟踪显著提高了圆形射野和临床胰腺计划的剂量精度，基于3%/2mm标准的平均伽马通过率从87.1%提升至99.9%。

结论：
本研究在临床MR-Linac上开发并验证了一种三维MRI引导的MLC跟踪技术。初步结果表明，对于运动靶区的治疗，MLC跟踪带来了显著的剂量学改善。

title: Meta-Initialization of Implicit Neural Representations to Accelerate Deformable Medical Image Registration
summary: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.
tldr: This paper studies using meta-initialization, via Reptile and STRAINER, to accelerate deformable medical image registration with implicit neural representations, showing faster early adaptation and improved Dice/HD95 compared with random initialization, though pretraining costs differ greatly.
tldr_zh: 本文研究通过元初始化（Reptile与STRAINER）加速基于隐式神经表示的可变形医学图像配准，实验显示早期配准质量优于随机初始化，但两种方法的预训练成本差异较大。
summary_zh:
摘要：
用于可变形医学图像配准的隐式神经表示（INR）方法需要针对每一对新图像对网络参数进行优化，这使得适应速度成为实际应用中的限制因素。本研究探讨是否可以利用从先前已解决的配准任务集合中学习到的初始化来加速早期适应。我们考察了两种方案：Reptile元初始化，以及STRAINER对坐标网络共享组件的迁移。KAN-IDIR被用作基础的INR位移场模型。实验在OASIS-1数据集上进行，其中364个连续图像对用于训练，49个图像对用于测试时的适应。配准质量通过平均Dice和HD95评估，同时记录第1500次迭代时雅可比行列式为负的体素比例。在所研究的配置中，两种方案在早期迭代阶段均比随机初始化获得更高的Dice和更低的HD95。在小迭代预算下，Reptile在数值上优于STRAINER，尽管它们的预训练预算并不匹配。随着迭代次数增加，两种方案之间的差异逐渐缩小。STRAINER预训练耗时39-40分钟，而Reptile则需44.98小时。

title: Vision Tomography: Towards Portable 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Inference from Visual Data
summary: Traditional computed tomography (CT) can capture paired 3D face and skull geometry, but it remains costly, fixed in location, and exposes patients to radiation. For applications such as remote diagnostics, digital healthcare, forensic identification, missing-person investigation, and archaeological analysis, there is an urgent need for a portable, safe, and accessible solution to capture 3D skull geometry. In this work, we introduce Vision Tomography (VT), a concept and framework capable of reconstructing paired 3D face-skull geometry from various visual modalities, and also enabling joint manipulation of 3D facial and skull geometry. To achieve this, we first construct a dataset of over 200 samples, where each case includes a CT-based skull, a CT-based face, and a high-fidelity textured face scan. Secondly, we propose a novel dense ray matching registration method that ensures topological consistency across face, skull, and their tissue correspondences. Building on this registration, we introduce the 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model (BFSM) as the foundation of Vision Tomography, which enables shape inference between the face and skull through a shared coefficient space, while also modeling tissue thickness variation to support one-to-many facial reconstructions from the same skull, reflecting individual facial changes such as age or body fat. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of Vision Tomography across various forensic and medical applications, including paired 3D face-skull reconstruction from images or sketches and predicting surgical outcomes with joint face-skull editing. Extensive experiments confirm the robustness and accuracy of our method. Vision Tomography is available at https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM
tldr: Introduces Vision Tomography, a framework and morphable model (BFSM) that reconstructs paired 3D face-skull geometry from visual inputs such as images and sketches, and supports joint face-skull editing for forensic and surgical-planning applications.
tldr_zh: 提出 Vision Tomography 框架与 BFSM 模型，可从图像/草图等视觉输入重建配对的 3D 人脸-颅骨几何，并支持联合编辑，应用于法医与手术规划等场景。
summary_zh: 传统的计算机断层扫描（CT）能够捕获成对的3D面部与颅骨几何结构，但其成本高昂、位置固定，并会使患者暴露于辐射之中。对于远程诊断、数字医疗、法医鉴定、失踪人员调查以及考古分析等应用场景，迫切需要一种便携、安全且易于获取的解决方案来捕获3D颅骨几何结构。在这项工作中，我们提出了视觉断层扫描（Vision Tomography, VT）这一概念与框架，它能够从多种视觉模态中重建配对的3D面部-颅骨几何结构，并支持对3D面部与颅骨几何结构的联合操控。为实现这一目标，我们首先构建了一个包含200多个样本的数据集，其中每个样本都包含基于CT的颅骨、基于CT的面部以及高保真纹理面部扫描。其次，我们提出了一种新颖的密集射线匹配配准方法，确保面部、颅骨及其组织对应关系之间的拓扑一致性。基于该配准，我们引入了3D双向面部-颅骨可变形模型（Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model, BFSM），作为视觉断层扫描的基础。该模型通过共享系数空间实现面部与颅骨之间的形状推断，同时建模组织厚度变化，以支持从同一颅骨重建一对多的面部形态，反映年龄或体脂等个体面部变化。最后，我们展示了视觉断层扫描在多种法医和医学应用中的有效性，包括从图像或素描重建配对的3D面部-颅骨结构，以及通过联合面部-颅骨编辑预测手术效果。大量实验证实了我们方法的鲁棒性和准确性。视觉断层扫描代码可在 https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM 获取。

title: A Differentiable, GPU-Accelerated Finite-Element Formulation in JAX for Large-Deformation Shells with Contact: Application to Patient-Specific Aortic Valve Simulation
summary: Patient-specific aortic-valve models can help assess how tissue properties and geometry influence leaflet deformation and coaptation, with potential to inform intervention planning. Large deformations, near-incompressibility, and evolving contact make these simulations computationally demanding and can challenge nonlinear convergence. Differentiable, GPU-accelerated methods offer efficient derivative evaluation and parallel computation, but their matrix-free application to soft-tissue shells with contact remains less established. We developed a forward solver using tatva's energy-based finite-element framework in JAX. The solver combines finite-strain extensible-director shells, hyperelastic constitutive models, and a finite-range repulsive contact energy. Nonlinear equilibrium is solved using a regularized, matrix-free Newton-Krylov method with two-level preconditioning. Automatic differentiation evaluates tangent-vector products without forming or storing the primary tangent matrix, while GPU execution parallelizes element and quadrature-point computations. Constitutive, shell, contact, and self-contact responses were assessed against analytical, semi-analytical, and published benchmarks. At a contact-free plate equilibrium, implicit sensitivities of the converged apex displacement to constitutive parameters, thickness, and pressure agreed with finite differences from independent nonlinear simulations. Simulations of three patient-specific aortic-valve models (two tricuspid and one bicuspid) achieved final relative equilibrium residuals below 10^-4. Median GPU runtimes were approximately 15-25 minutes, with 5.3-6.5-fold speedups relative to corresponding CPU runs on the tested hardware. These results provide component-level verification and demonstrate GPU-accelerated forward valve simulation in the tested cases, supporting future gradient-based inverse studies.
tldr: Presents a differentiable, GPU-accelerated finite-element solver in JAX for large-deformation shells with contact, applied to patient-specific aortic valve simulations with verified accuracy and significant CPU-to-GPU speedups.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于JAX的可微分、GPU加速的有限元求解器，用于大变形壳体与接触问题，并应用于患者特异性主动脉瓣模拟，验证了准确性并实现了显著的CPU到GPU加速。
summary_zh: 患者特异性主动脉瓣模型有助于评估组织特性和几何形状如何影响瓣叶变形与对合，并有可能为干预规划提供参考。大变形、近不可压缩性以及不断演变的接触使这些模拟计算量巨大，并可能对非线性收敛构成挑战。可微分的GPU加速方法能够提供高效的导数计算和并行运算，但其无矩阵方法在涉及接触的软组织壳结构中的应用尚不成熟。我们利用JAX中基于tatva能量有限元框架开发了一个前向求解器。该求解器结合了有限应变可扩展方向壳、超弹性本构模型以及有限范围排斥接触能。非线性平衡通过正则化的无矩阵Newton-Krylov方法并辅以两级预处理求解。自动微分用于计算切向量积，而无需组装或存储主切矩阵，同时GPU执行并行化了单元和积分点计算。本构、壳、接触和自接触响应均针对解析、半解析及已发表的基准进行了评估。在无接触板平衡状态下，收敛顶点位移对本构参数、厚度和压力的隐式灵敏度与独立非线性模拟的有限差分结果一致。对三个患者特异性主动脉瓣模型（两个三叶瓣和一个二叶瓣）的模拟实现了最终相对平衡残差低于10^-4。在所测试硬件上，GPU运行时间中位数约为15至25分钟，相对于相应CPU运行实现了5.3至6.5倍的加速。这些结果提供了分量级验证，并在测试案例中展示了GPU加速的前向瓣膜模拟，支持未来基于梯度的逆问题研究。

title: Fu-TCM: a multimodal large language model that learns traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are advancing in multimodal understanding and reasoning, accelerating medical model development. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) uses evidence from the four examinations to determine disease location and nature, differentiate syndromes and guide treatment. This diagnostic process constitutes a complete chain of reasoning. We present Fu-TCM, a multimodal TCM LLM trained on data retained after cleaning and filtering an initial collection of approximately 7.12 million examples derived from classical texts, textbooks, medical images, clinical cases and publicly available datasets. The model was further optimized using Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization (BGPO), which explicitly targets syndrome differentiation through rewards for response format, intermediate TCM reasoning fields and final syndrome predictions. Fu-TCM-27B led all six benchmarks spanning TCM reasoning, text and vision, achieving a macro-average accuracy of 81.01% and surpassing the strongest reference model with complete results across all six benchmarks by 7.13 percentage points. Its largest margin was 11.90 points on Fu-bianzheng. Case-level analyses further showed a positive association between intermediate-field accuracy and final syndrome-selection accuracy in most evaluated models. These findings suggest that TCM syndrome differentiation may be computationally learnable and that structured reasoning supervision can improve performance across TCM tasks.
tldr: Fu-TCM is a 27B multimodal large language model for traditional Chinese medicine, trained on 7.12M cleaned examples and optimized with Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization (BGPO). It achieves state-of-the-art results across six TCM reasoning, text, and vision benchmarks, suggesting structured syndrome-differentiation reasoning supervision improves TCM performance.
tldr_zh: Fu-TCM 是一个面向中医的 27B 多模态大语言模型，基于约 712 万清洗后的样本训练，并使用辨证接地策略优化（BGPO）。它在六个中医推理、文本和视觉基准上达到最优结果，表明结构化辨证推理监督可提升中医任务表现。
summary_zh:
摘要：
大语言模型（LLMs）在多模态理解与推理方面持续进步，加速了医学模型的发展。中医通过四诊获取证据，判断病位与病性，辨别证候并指导治疗，这一诊断过程构成了一条完整的推理链。我们提出了Fu-TCM，一种多模态中医大语言模型，其训练数据来源于对约712万个初始样本进行清洗与过滤后的结果，这些样本来自典籍、教材、医学图像、临床病例及公开数据集。该模型进一步采用基于辨证的策略优化（BGPO）进行优化，该方法通过针对回答格式、中医中间推理字段及最终证候预测的奖励，显式地引导辨证过程。Fu-TCM-27B在涵盖中医推理、文本与视觉的六项基准测试中均名列前茅，宏平均准确率达到81.01%，比在全部六项基准上均取得完整结果的最强参考模型高出7.13个百分点；其在Fu-bianzheng上的优势最大，达11.90个百分点。病例级分析进一步表明，在大多数被评估模型中，中间字段准确率与最终证候选择准确率之间存在正相关关系。这些发现提示，中医证候辨别可能在计算上是可学习的，结构化推理监督能够提升中医各类任务的性能。
